title: Bounded process probes
responsibility: Provides bounded system-tool calls for reading process state and executable paths, with shared concurrency control.

inputs.name: processProbes.limits
inputs.description: Optional cancellation signal and per-tool timeout in milliseconds; default timeout is 3000.

outputs.name: processProbes
outputs.description: Probe methods for running tools, reading process facts with ps and resolving executable paths with lsof. At most eight tools run concurrently process-wide; timeout/cancellation/failure yields not-ok, and unreadable facts or paths yield null.
